help_desc: Toggles the bot icon (ADC CT bot bit) on a registered account without changing its privileges.
msg_denied: You are not allowed to use this command.
msg_notify: An operator changed your bot-icon flag (%s). Reconnect for it to take effect.
msg_ok: Bot icon flag for '%s' set to %s. It takes effect at the account's next login.
msg_reg: User '%s' is not a registered account (or is an in-hub bot).
